title: Redirect stale Super Admin plugins and groups URLs
summary: Stale Super Admin addresses for Plugins and Groups now send people to the live Admin pages instead of a bare Laravel 404.
changes: Redirect /superadmin/plugins and the older /superadmin/modules address to the live Plugins page at /admin/modules.
Redirect /superadmin/groups to the live Groups address at /admin/groups, which continues into the Access Groups tab.
Keep Super Admin navigation pointed at the live Access and Plugins pages so those chrome links do not use the stale addresses.
version_rationale: Patch release: restores existing Super Admin Plugins and Groups destinations without adding a new workspace.
validation: PHPUnit AdminAccessWorkspaceTest covers guest login redirects, administrator 403s, Super Admin redirects from /superadmin/plugins and /superadmin/groups, and follow-through to the live Admin pages.
AdminAccessAndViewsTest covers administrator, public, and volunteer denials of the stale Super Admin addresses.
AuthorizationRuntimeSourceContractTest covers changelog internal-note visibility using staff, volunteer, and student permission gates rather than a scalar staff helper.
Ran php artisan myapes:changelog-validate against the changelog guest-filter parent branch for this stacked change.
known_limitations: Unknown URLs still show the default Laravel 404. Branded unknown-URL pages remain a separate change. Hub Create/View addresses are a separate change.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. Stale Super Admin Plugins and Groups addresses would 404 again.
provenance: Defined by the stale Super Admin route fix for MyAPES Account issue #133, stacked on pull request #164, and pull request #165.
